sn24.37:1.1: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā || || Rūpe
sn24.37:2.1: kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Vedanāya sati || pe || Saññāya sati || Saṅkhāresu sati || Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati || Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || ||
sn24.37:3.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || pa || || Vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya Rūpī attā {hoti} arogo param maraṇā ti || || No hetam bhante || || Vedanā || pa || No hetam bhante || || Iti kho bhikkhave dukkhe sati dukkham upādāya dukkham abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati Rūpī attā hoti arogo param maraṇā ti || || Sāvatthi || ||
